# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Filtered rendering corrections**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.157.0 update corrects image-subset sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering. The native Skia m157 corrections also make image-filter cache keys consistent with hashing. The managed and C API surfaces remain unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Preserve image subsets under antialiasing** — Image filtering and texture sampling respect logical bounds under minification, strong skew, AA clipping and MSAA. Strict sampling constraints prevent unrelated backing-store texels from leaking into filtered images when padding is insufficient. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Align image-filter cache equality with hashing** — Bytewise key comparison distinguishes signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata, avoiding floating-point-mode-dependent equality and keeping cache lookups and LRU eviction consistent. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Correct mask-filtered glyph reloads** — Text rasterization uses the reloaded glyph's own outline when font-scaler loads change. Incompatible masks produce cleared output instead of unsafe copies or format assertions, while clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides and SDF overlap remains intact. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
